snippet.title: MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice | Star and Stripe DLC Character Trailer
snippet.description:
I might not know what you’re up to, but I’m going to win NO MATTER WHAT!
America’s Number One Pro Hero - Star and Stripe - arrives in MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice!

MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice is available now PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam!

Get it here: https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/my-hero-academia-alls-justice

The MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice Deluxe Edition includes the base game and the Season Pass – including 5 additional playable characters to be released post-launch.
The Ultimate Edition includes the base game, the Season Pass, 20 additional costumes, and 7 HUD banners.

#MHA #MHAAJ
